changelog: 1.0.6: security-review fixes — the session-service rule is now one consistent refuse-by-default policy (single explicit-informed-override exception), and 'charge -> proceed silently' is gone: every mainnet payment goes through pay-per-call's confirmation gate.
summary: Discover paid API services available via MPP Router (apiserver.mpprouter.dev) that accept Stellar USDC payments. Triggers on prompts like "summarize X using parallel.ai via MPPRouter", "search with exa via mpp", "find a service for <task>", "list mpp services", "what APIs can I pay for with stellar". Fetches the live service catalog, picks a matching service, and hands off to the pay-per-call sub-skill to actually invoke it.
